description:
Project Overview

This PhD uses optical measurements to understand polymer-based electronic devices while they operate. The goal is to connect material behaviour with device stability and energy-efficient computing.

Research Position Overview

Select conductive polymers, fabricate devices and develop in-situ UV–Vis, Raman and surface-enhanced Raman measurements. Analyse charge transfer, redox behaviour and material changes during electrical operation.

Research Areas

  • Neuromorphic optoelectronics
  • Conductive polymers
  • In-operando spectroscopy
